text: 一目科技完成E轮超10亿元融资，估值突破100亿元。本轮融资由多家一线人民币基金、头部美元基金和知名产业方联合参与，庚辛资本担任长期财务顾问。所融资金将用于具身智能触觉感知材料、芯片、算法和模型的研发，以及产线订单的规模化量产和高质量交付。（新浪科技）
text_en: Yimu Technology completed Series E financing of over 1 billion yuan, with its valuation exceeding 10 billion yuan. The round was co-participated in by multiple first-tier RMB funds, top-tier USD funds, and well-known industry players, with Gengxin Capital serving as the long-term financial advisor. The funds raised will be used for R&D of embodied intelligent tactile sensing materials, chips, algorithms, and models, as well as scaled production and high-quality delivery of line orders. (Sina Tech)
